description: A React component implementing a draft persona review/edit page for a web application, involving user profile editing, skills management, and navigation to a skill validation step.

classes.name: PlaceholderAvatarIcon
classes.description: SVG icon used as a placeholder avatar when user has not uploaded a profile picture.

classes.name: PencilIcon
classes.description: SVG icon representing a pencil, used for editing profile picture.

classes.name: CheckIcon
classes.description: SVG icon representing a check mark, used in success toast.

classes.name: SkillChip
classes.description: Component displaying a skill tag, with optional remove button in edit mode.

classes.name: TextInput
classes.description: Reusable input component with label for text fields.

classes.name: Textarea
classes.description: Reusable multi-line text input component with label.

classes.name: ExperienceCard
classes.description: Component for displaying or editing a work experience entry.

classes.name: WorkStyleInsight
classes.description: Component for displaying inferred work style traits.

classes.name: SuccessToast
classes.description: Component showing a transient success message after saving.

classes.name: DraftPersonaPage
classes.description: Main React component for the draft persona review/edit page with profile, skills, experience, and navigation functionalities.

methods.name: onPickAvatar
methods.description: Handles avatar file selection, validating image types, generating an object URL, and updating state.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Persists current edits into local state and sets a success toast.

methods.name: confirmAndContinue
methods.description: Ensures latest edits are saved into the flow state and navigates to the skill validation page.

methods.name: updateIdentity
methods.description: Updates the professional identity fields of the persona.

methods.name: updateHighlight
methods.description: Updates a specific key experience highlight.

methods.name: addSkill
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the skills list if it is not a duplicate.

methods.name: removeSkill
methods.description: Removes a specified skill from the skills list.
